paragraphs: I'm applying for the Capital Markets Analyst - Project Finance role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Palmetto stands out to me because the role ties solar loan origination and customer financing directly to tax equity funds and ABS, which is the part of energy finance I most want to work in.

The closest work I've done is an MBA project on a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio. I built project and portfolio models covering capital structure, DSCR, NPV and levered IRR under post-ITC scenarios, compared senior debt, sustainability-linked loan and green loan plus ABS structures, and recommended a phased green loan + ABS approach that reduced sponsor equity by $11.1M in the model. At Thomson Reuters I managed cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows and supported monthly P&L forecasting and close for the ANZ region.

That mix fits the recurring fund and investor reporting this team owns: large datasets, repeatable templates, and numbers that have to tie out every month. My solar finance work is coursework, not live deals, so I'd be learning Palmetto's funding structures on the job, but I'm comfortable in Excel with big data sets and I care about getting reporting right. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
